newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to privatise two large Kiev hotels - Fund.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to privatise two large Kiev hotels - Fund.

text.p: Ukraine's State Property Fund (FDM), the state privatisation agency, announced on Wednesday it is seeking consulting firms to conduct the sale of majority stakes in two large Kiev hotels.
"The sale will be no less than 51 percent of shares in the Kievska Rus and Dnipro hotels," an FDM statement said.
Foreign investors, forced to stay in Soviet-era hotels which often lack heating or hot water, have complained that Ukraine's capital city has no Western-style hotel or convention centre.
Several international firms have announced plans to build hotels in Kiev.
